test_autoround_quantize_and_save: test the AutoRound quantize_and_save method to quantize a model and save it to disk
test_4bit_symmetric_quantization: test 4-bit symmetric quantization of a causal LM model using AutoRound with group size 128
test_model_generation_after_quantization: test text generation from a quantized model loaded via AutoModelForCausalLM on CPU
test_autoround_with_dataloader: test AutoRound quantization using a dataloader dataset with configurable iterations and sequence length
test_quantized_model_reload_and_generate: test reloading a quantized model and tokenizer then generating text with max new tokens
